_about: v75 (my drafts, for the lawyer's review): the candidate lines by role that come from the matter, not from a record of their own (src/rag/lawyer_method.py thesis_candidates). «matters»: a civil claim's matter by its article's place in the c.c. (range: first and last article); the attore's remedies, the convenuto's eccezioni -- each line offered on the claim record's elements. «penal_property»: the c.p. range of the offences against property, whose victim is offered sequestro and restituzione. v76: «fallback» -- the civil role's line when the record offers none (never the penal containment).
